correctness.rationale: For H=P_n or C_n, a blue vertex has at least r-2 white neighbors in bar H when r whites remain, forbidding first forces for r>=4. With r=3 exactly the degree-two-neighbor triples admit a first force; with two remaining whites distinct H outside-pair neighborhoods yield a force, and with one white min degree of bar H suffices. Exact center/triple incidence counting gives (n-2)(n-3)-(n-4) for paths and n(n-3)-n except n=6 where two triples have triple multiplicity. Direct independent simulations over all 65,472 subsets of 20 labeled graph instances agree with the complete formulas and configuration criterion.

originality.rationale: The principal 2022 paper yields the scalar Z=n-3 for complement paths/cycles but does not enumerate the minimum sets or entire polynomials. The 2018 polynomial study counts ordinary paths/cycles and gives universal upper coefficients, but neither its graph families nor its general coefficients cover the n-3 term in the complementary graphs. The searched research records have other graph families; residual risk from unindexed or unidentified stronger results is explicit.

value.rationale: The full minimum-set configuration space in canonical graph complements was not determined by their known equal zero-forcing numbers. The complete two-family polynomial identifies a natural single-edge perturbation changing only one coefficient, gives an exact exceptional six-cycle correction, and supplies a structural enumeration for all graph orders rather than arbitrary isolated instances.
